statements.text: An epistemic agent model (EAM) is a special type of self-model in which the system is represented as an individual entity capable of epistemic self-control, standing in or actively building knowledge relations to parts of the world. Attentional agency is enough for an EAM, and cognitive agency is not required.

sources.quote: An EAM is a special type of PSM, allowing a cognitive system to develop a genuine first-person perspective.
AA is sufficient for having an EAM, CA is not a necessary condition.
